final: WITH film_counts AS (SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS actor_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY film_id), first_avg AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count FROM film_counts), above_first AS (SELECT fc.film_id, fc.actor_count, fc.actor_count - fa.avg_count AS excess_first FROM film_counts fc CROSS JOIN first_avg fa WHERE fc.actor_count > fa.avg_count), second_avg AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count FROM above_first), remaining AS (SELECT af.actor_count, af.excess_first, af.actor_count - sa.avg_count AS excess_second FROM above_first af CROSS JOIN second_avg sa WHERE af.actor_count > sa.avg_count) SELECT SUM(actor_count) AS sum_actor_counts, AVG(excess_first) AS avg_excess_over_first_average, AVG(excess_second) AS avg_excess_over_second_average FROM remaining
